_purpose: Core Positions, ATO Protection, Deployment Wizard for Kavach 2.0
_file_role: Tunable parameters ONLY. Secrets (token, chat_id) live in token.env.

quiet_hours._comment: Outbound proactive notifications suppressed outside this window. Commands and wizard work 24/7 for Kavach 2.0.

commands._comment: Toggle individual commands on/off without restarting the bot. confirm_deploy is RETIRED.

confirmations._comment: Commands that require an explicit yes/no reply before executing. Prevents accidental triggers.

notifications._comment: Which trade events KAVACH bot should announce via Telegram. Quiet hours apply.

ato_monitoring._comment: ATO monitoring window (IST). Start 09:20 (same clock as overnight morning handoff). End 15:25 — no new ATO buys after end even if Hedge Box did not buy.

strategy._lot_size_comment: NIFTY index options lot size — broker positions are qty; divide by this for lots.

ato_operator._comment: Operator rules — docs/KAVACH_ATO_OPERATOR_RULES.md. No hardcoded limits in code.
ato_operator._limit_buffer_pct_comment: ATO only — aggressive LIMIT = LTP ± this % (BUY above, SELL below). SEBI/algo MARKET ban workaround.

deploy_wizard._ato_step_comment: NIFTY strike interval for ATO protection. PE_ATO = pe_sell_strike - ato_step. CE_ATO = ce_sell_strike + ato_step.
deploy_wizard._wizard_timeout_comment: Seconds of user inactivity before wizard auto-cancels. No file written on timeout.

position_filter._comment: Rules applied to broker open positions before displaying in wizard.
position_filter._underlying_comment: Only show positions whose underlying is NIFTY. Rejects SENSEX, BANKNIFTY, equity, futures.
position_filter._option_types_comment: Only options shown. Futures and equity are excluded even if underlying matches.

storage._comment: On /deploy start: all *.json in active_dir are moved to archive_dir before wizard runs.

retry._comment: Retry behaviour for broker API calls (position fetch, order placement).
